position.title: position
position.description: `Vector` [x y z] of the position of the block to modify.

slotid.title: slotId
slotid.description: An `integer` that sets the slot to be modified. Default: `0`.

itemname.title: itemName
itemname.description: Specifies the item to be placed in the entity or block inventory slot.

amount.title: amount
amount.description: An `integer` to specify the number of items to place in inventory. Default: `1`.

data.title: data
data.description: An `integer` that specifies the item data for the items in the inventory. Default: `0`.

components.title: components
components.description: A `JSON` object that supports `minecraft:can_place_on`, `minecraft:can_destroy`, `minecraft:item_lock`, and `minecraft:keep_on_death`. Default: `false`.

target.title: target
target.description: Specifies the entity to modify, either a player name or a [target selector](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors).

olditemhandling.title: oldItemHandling
olditemhandling.description: Either `destroy` to replace items in slot or `keep` to keep items instead of replacing them.
